dge spyod yan lag gsum pa
item.coloph: de ltar yan lag gsum pa'i bon 'di dag rgod lcam don 'bar thugs kyi spral pa ste/ yum cig mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma yi (yis/)lo rgyal byi ba mgo yi dus bzang la/ nges med sprang po bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis gsang sbas bka' rgya thub par byas/ de ltar yos lo ston zla 'bring po la/ dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis rkyen bskal nas/ gnas la khyad 'phags su ze zab mo'i sgang / mtsho gling rgya mtsho klu'i pho brang du/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ bka' skyong mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ lnga brgya'i dus ngan bskal pa'i snyigs ma 'di/ 'dzam gling dbus kyi kha ba can ljongs su/ bstan pa'i bon 'di dar rgyas 'phel nas su/ gdul bya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa yi/ mkha' la nyi shar bzhin du gsal bar shog/

item.tib: dge spyod yan lag gsum pa
